parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington experienced a power failure causing production to stop from 2027-03-24 through 2027-03-25 inclusive. The control tower rescheduled 6 production orders at the same plant, notified 25 dealers once each for 56 customer orders, and assigned 15 loaners.
parsed.decision_reason: The system acted because it was a real incident classified as plant_outage, where all IDs and dates were resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write.
